description.value: Ron's Kitchen is a Persian-pizza fusion restaurant in Port Coquitlam operated by Chef Ron, a culinary veteran who was named Chef of the Year at Earls Restaurant Group in Canada in 2019. Opened in 2024, the kitchen specializes in authentic Persian dishes — including hot, fresh Tahdig — alongside creative pizzas infused with Middle Eastern flavors. Cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities will find a distinctive sit-down and takeout option with a menu that blends traditional Persian technique with Western influences.
